parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Number of planning stages in the horizon, indexed by t = 0, ..., T-1

parameters.name: demand_profile
parameters.description: Number of usable tools required at each stage t

parameters.name: purchase_cost
parameters.description: Unit cost to purchase a new tool

parameters.name: slow_repair_unit_cost
parameters.description: Unit cost of sending a used tool to slow repair

parameters.name: slow_repair_return_delay
parameters.description: Return delay in stages for slow repair

parameters.name: fast_repair_unit_cost
parameters.description: Unit cost of sending a used tool to fast repair

parameters.name: fast_repair_return_delay
parameters.description: Return delay in stages for fast repair

parameters.name: initial_available_tools
parameters.description: Initial number of usable tools available before stage t = 0

parameters.name: purchase_capacity
parameters.description: Optional maximum number of tools that can be purchased at each stage t

parameters.name: slow_repair_capacity
parameters.description: Optional maximum number of tools that can be sent to slow repair after each stage t

parameters.name: fast_repair_capacity
parameters.description: Optional maximum number of tools that can be sent to fast repair after each stage t

variables.name: purchase_plan
variables.description: Number of new tools purchased at each stage t

variables.name: slow_repair_plan
variables.description: Number of tools sent to slow repair after each stage t

variables.name: fast_repair_plan
variables.description: Number of tools sent to fast repair after each stage t

variables.name: availability_profile
variables.description: Number of tools available at the start of each stage t

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_decision_variables
constraints.description: All decision variables are nonnegative integers.

constraints.name: nonnegative_data_parameters
constraints.description: Demand, costs, delays, and capacities are nonnegative; capacities are integer-valued when provided.

constraints.name: stage_demand_satisfaction
constraints.description: At each stage, available tools plus purchases and returned repairs must be sufficient to satisfy that stage's demand exactly.

constraints.name: exclusive_repair_routing
constraints.description: Tools used in a stage are assigned to exactly one repair mode afterward.
constraints.formula: exactly one repair mode per used tool

constraints.name: repair_capacity_limits
constraints.description: Stage-t purchases and repair assignments may not exceed optional stage-dependent capacities when provided.

constraints.name: availability_from_elapsed_returns_only
constraints.description: Tools become available only from earlier purchases and from repairs whose delays have already elapsed.
constraints.formula: I_t = I_{t-1} + x_{t-1} + \sum_{\tau=0}^{t-p-1} y^{slow}_\tau + \sum_{\tau=0}^{t-q-1} y^{fast}_\tau - R_{t-1}

constraints.name: horizon_truncation_of_late_returns
constraints.description: Tools returning after the end of the planning horizon do not contribute to feasibility inside the horizon.
constraints.formula: \sum_{\tau=T-p}^{T-1} y^{slow}_\tau \text{ and } \sum_{\tau=T-q}^{T-1} y^{fast}_\tau \text{ are excluded from any } I_t \text{ with } t \leq T-1

constraints.name: inventory_balance_and_demand_satisfaction
constraints.description: For each stage, the available tools at the start of the stage must exactly satisfy demand when combined with same-stage purchases and returns from repairs completed by that stage. This enforces exact satisfaction and defines the availability profile recursively.
constraints.formula: I_t + x_t + \sum_{\tau=0}^{t-p} y^{slow}_\tau \mathbf{1}_{t-p\ge 0} + \sum_{\tau=0}^{t-q} y^{fast}_\tau \mathbf{1}_{t-q\ge 0} = R_t + \sum_{\tau=0}^{t-1} y^{slow}_\tau + \sum_{\tau=0}^{t-1} y^{fast}_\tau

constraints.name: initial_availability_definition
constraints.description: The availability at the first stage equals the initially available tools.

constraints.name: repair_routing_equals_used_tools
constraints.description: Every tool used in a stage is routed to exactly one repair mode after that stage, so the total number sent to repair equals stage demand.

constraints.name: purchase_capacity_limits
constraints.description: If purchase capacities are provided, purchases at each stage cannot exceed the corresponding capacity.

constraints.name: slow_repair_capacity_limits
constraints.description: If slow repair capacities are provided, the number of tools sent to slow repair at each stage cannot exceed the corresponding capacity.

constraints.name: fast_repair_capacity_limits
constraints.description: If fast repair capacities are provided, the number of tools sent to fast repair at each stage cannot exceed the corresponding capacity.

constraints.name: nonnegativity_and_integrality_of_decision_variables
constraints.description: Decision variables are nonnegative integers to represent counts of tools and to preserve exact discrete tool flows.

objectives.name: total_tool_related_spending_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize total tool-related spending over the horizon, including purchase costs and repair costs.

final_objective.description: Minimize total tool-related spending over the horizon, consisting of purchase costs and both repair mode costs.
final_objective.formula: Z = a \sum_{t=0}^{T-1} x_t + b \sum_{t=0}^{T-1} y^{slow}_t + c \sum_{t=0}^{T-1} y^{fast}_t
